# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Purpose

This is a training repository (`CAPACITACIONES`) focused on showcasing and documenting new features and updates (`novedades`) of the GitHub Copilot CLI. Content is intended for onboarding and education — always example-driven.

## Repository Structure

- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — This file; provides context for Copilot sessions.
- `.github/skills/` — GitHub Copilot Skills definitions for use in demos and training.
- `README.md` — Top-level overview of the repository.

## Conventions

- All new content should demonstrate Copilot CLI features with concrete, runnable examples rather than abstract descriptions.
- Skills defined under `.github/skills/` follow the GitHub Copilot Skills YAML format. Each skill should include a clear `description` and `steps` that illustrate a specific feature.
- Documentation language is flexible (Spanish or English), matching the audience of the training session.
